by_task.procedure: After classifying specific exemptions, make a separate asset-by-asset wildcard pass. Its ceiling limits protected value, not EC eligibility.
by_task.avoid_when: Skip § 522(d)(5) only when federal exemptions are unavailable or the facts do not show a debtor interest. Do not skip it because another exemption applies or the asset exceeds the ceiling.

by_task.when: Federal exemptions are allowable and the debtor or debtors own an estate asset.
by_task.procedure: For every owned asset, add a separate 11 U.S.C. § 522(d)(5) output entry after evaluating specific exemptions. Evaluate that asset-exemption pair independently, so a simultaneously listed § 522(d)(1) entry does not consume the wildcard base. Use a $15,425 whole-asset ceiling for one debtor or $30,850 for two equal joint debtors, and report the lesser of the asset's value and that ceiling. Before submitting, verify that every owned asset has its (d)(5) entry alongside all specific alternatives.
by_task.avoid_when: Do not use § 522(d)(5) when federal exemptions are unavailable, omit it because a specific exemption applies, default to $1,475 despite unused § 522(d)(1) capacity, or return only one debtor's half-interest.
